title: Rule (front-matter)
description: The YAML front-matter of a rule file (rules/<area>/<name>.md). The Markdown body below it holds the rule in words with sections '## Why', '## Examples' and '## Open questions'. Machine checks for the rule sit beside it in <name>.checks.json. Compatible with RaD rule files; 'from' is accepted as an alias of 'layer'. Distil phase.

id.description: Domain prefix, area code, number: DDS-PARAM-003.

area.description: The folder under rules/: naming, parameters, nesting, geometry, views-and-sheets …

appliesTo.description: Subject scopes the rule applies to, adapter vocabulary; ['all'] for everything.

status.description: Alias of lifecycle, for RaD compatibility. If both are present they must match.

layer.description: The id of the pack (layer) this rule belongs to.

overrides.description: The id of a rule in a lower layer that this rule replaces.
